data.narrative:
Retro Biosciences is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Joe Betts-LaCroix, evaluated against a peer set of 3 public and 8 private companies in the Biotech & Health sector. Top private comparables include Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome. Public anchors (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) trade at a median EV/Sales of 6.2x, though this multiple cannot be directly applied without the target's disclosed revenue.

Stage-progression analysis proves the primary applicable method. Using $180M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $360M. This reflects standard investor return expectations at the stage. Peer-median triangulation could not be executed due to insufficient narrow comparables (fewer than 3 same-stage or adjacent-stage biotech peers with disclosed valuations), and public-comp anchoring is inapplicable because Retro Biosciences' revenue is not on file, as is typical for private-stage companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $306M to $414M, centered on $360M. The primary uncertainty stems from reliance on a single applicable method; a more robust range would require either disclosed revenue for public-multiple anchoring or access to 3+ narrowly comparable Series A biotech valuations. Stage-progression multipliers also vary materially by sub-sector and capital intensity within biotech, which this analysis does not isolate.
